title: FR: Alarm clock
body: It will be nice to have  in xDrip alarm clock or (maybe even better) timer that (with choosable sound) can be spedified like insulin/carbs/BG, but in FUTURE time.

comments.body:
You can use your smartphone alarm, can't you?
What exactly do you expect xDrip to do that you cannot do with a regular clock included with Android?

**Navid200**,

`You can use your smartphone alarm, can't you?`
Yes. But that won't be done in Xdrip. ;)

`What exactly do you expect xDrip to do that you cannot do with a regular clock included with Android?`
Actualy nothing, but it'd wish to stay in one window.

@ARkaine2 We don't have the time to reinvent the wheel. Instead, we like to focus on the existing bugs and features. xDrip has a lot of features and settings, already and it is hard do support it. We are a very small dev team.
Contributions and PRs are always welcome.
